visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens on a large outdoor LED stadium display under a heavy downpour at night. On the screen, two men in baseball attire are visible. The man on the left wears a bright red jersey and black goggles, while the man on the right (the main character) wears a maroon jersey, white pants, and a red cap worn backward. He holds a microphone to his face and smiles broadly. (2) Below the screen, a large crowd of spectators is gathered behind a stadium fence adorned with multiple white 'MAXXIS' logos. The foreground shows several people in baseball uniforms standing with their backs to the camera, some wearing helmets, watching the screen. Rain streaks are highly visible against the dark sky and the bright screen. (3) The main character on the screen continues to speak and laugh, his mouth moving in an animated fashion. The crowd in the foreground remains static, looking upward. A large white logo with the letter 'P' and the text 'PP 石墨烯' is visible on the right side of the stadium structure. The lighting is bright from the stadium floodlights and the LED screen itself.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with the sound of a heavy rain atmosphere mixed with a cheerful, upbeat electronic BGM track. A male voice, broadcast through stadium speakers, speaks in a friendly and teasing tone, joking about fans taking leave to attend the game. (2) As he speaks, the background noise is filled with a dense crowd murmur. Every few seconds, the speaker lets out a short laugh, and the crowd responds with collective light laughter and cheering. (3) Towards the end, the speaker makes a concluding joke, triggering a massive roar of high-arousal cheering and applause from the crowd that almost masks the music. The BGM continues steadily throughout, providing a comedic and lighthearted backdrop to the speech.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video captures a viral humorous moment during a professional baseball game in Taiwan. The player, Chen Chen-wei, jokes with the fans about their dedication to coming to the stadium despite the rain and taking leave from work, promising to 'pay their salaries,' which leads to a loud, joyful reaction from the stadium crowd. The intent is to share a heartwarming and funny interaction between an athlete and his supporters.
